events.verdict: Rondo (LAL) briefly places his hand on Collins' (ATL) hip, but does not affect his FOM.
Dedmon (ATL) avoids making contact with Bullock (LAL) during the pick, who makes incidental foot contact with Kuzma (LAL).
Ingram (LAL) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Prince (ATL) after the release that does not affect his jump shot attempt.
Dedmon (ATL) makes marginal contact to the body of James (LAL) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
James (LAL) makes contact to the off-arm of Young (ATL) during his driving shot attempt.
[Observable in enhanced video] James (LAL) enters the lane prior to the release of the free throw shot by Young (ATL).
Bullock (LAL) slightly extends his arm into the body of Collins (ATL), but does not dislodge him from his legally obtained position.
Huerter (ATL) slightly extends his arm into the body of Kuzma (LAL) during the rebound.
Collins (ATL) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Bullock (LAL) and absorbs the contact during the pick.
Bullock (LAL) leans into the body of Collins' (ATL), but the contact does not dislodge Collins from his legally obtained position prior to his shot attempt in the post.
James (LAL) is in the paint for less than three seconds when the shot is imminent.
Bullock (LAL) has a resting hand on Collins' (ATL) body that does not affect his shot attempt in the lane.
Rondo (LAL) makes contact to the arm of Collins (ATL) after securing the rebound, but the contact does not affect Collins' control of the ball.
Rondo (LAL) commits a take foul on Young (ATL).
Kuzma (LAL) makes clean contact to the ball as Dedmon (ATL) receives the inbounds pass.
Young (ATL) slightly extends his arm to the body of Bullock (LAL) as he attempts to make a play on the ball, but the contact does not dislodge Bullock from his legally obtained position.
Young (ATL) makes marginal contact to the arm of James (LAL) during his shooting motion that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
James (LAL) puts a forearm to the front of Young (ATL), but does not affect his SQBR.
[Observable in enhanced video] Rondo (LAL) enters the lane and does not reestablish position outside of the lane prior to the release of the free throw shot by Huerter (ATL).
Rondo (LAL) makes contact to the arm of Huerter (ATL) as he makes a play on the ball while in possession of Huerter.
Prince (ATL) makes marginal contact with James (LAL) prior to the inbounds pass and does not dislodge him from his legally obtained position.
Bazemore (ATL) makes clean contact to the ball during the inbounds pass to Ingram (LAL).
Prince (ATL) makes contact to the arm of Ingram (LAL) during the inbounds, but does not affect his FOM.
